research.notes: No phone, general email, CA entity number, EIN or UEI found on the company's own pages; the CA Secretary of State record was not located, so those fields are null. profile.summary: A company based in Oakland, California, that provides consulting in equity and inclusion, youth development, organizational capacity building and strategic planning. It also offers curricula and training for youth programs, including after-school programs, on topics such as social-emotional learning and restorative practices.

review.notes: Be the Change Consulting, LLC is an Oakland-based for-profit LLC (410 12th St. Ste. 200) whose site confirms the legal name, address, and equity, youth development, capacity building and strategic planning services plus after-school SEL/restorative practices curricula, matching OUSD's agenda name (including the LLC form) and its after-school and student-support contracts. I could not verify the candidate's claim that a Custom Solutions page lists OUSD, but that is only an identity signal and no profile field depends on it.
